items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Paul Whiteman's band, you know... Even Paul Whiteman in there. He walked up on the stage and actually told an audience once... I'm introducing to you the King of Jazz.

ctx.x: Yeah, Lucille Ball, Rita Hayworth, people like that. And I used to ask Miss Sutton, ask her about who is that man, you know. And she explained that he was the great -- he was the great tap dancer, you know, in show business, and her husband was a fan of his. They were kind of friends of some sort, you know.

She says, he was going to be in Philadelphia pretty soon, and she was going to take us to see him. He was going to be at the Hippodrome Theater. They was having, I think, a charity show. And these important schools, they was going to have some choir, boys' choir from Notre Dame or some important school, was going to sing, and Paul Whiteman's band, you know.
